decisions.reason: A water phantom for particle therapy builds directly on the firm's decades of scanning-phantom and dosimetry know-how, and it is only just being released in 2019, so the firm can interpret early results and refine it.
Small volume ionization chambers are the firm's core dosimetry competence, backed by accredited calibration and its own R&D, so absorptive capacity is high.
This second small-volume chamber sits squarely within the firm's existing detector knowledge, which lets it learn from field results and keep improving the product.
A multi-model line of standard clinical ionization chambers is the heart of the firm's established business and fits its knowledge base perfectly.
A relative-dosimetry chamber complements the firm's phantoms and software, so it lies close to existing knowledge and is easy to assimilate.
A thimble ionization chamber is a classic dosimetry product in which the firm has deep expertise and calibration capability, making retention likely.
